text_block_list.text: One night, at the training track...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, I hit my target. Time for a
break.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Oh, City. You're still at it this late?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, Yukino. Yeah, and I still have
more to
go.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I lost big time in class the other day.
Was a bit of
a wake-up call.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ohh, so that's why you're pushing
yourself... I've
got a lot to learn from
you!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You've got it backwards, if
anything! I
mean, I lost.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And it doesn't matter if I push myself if I
end up
losing anyways, you know?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...You think so? But, I really admire your
tenacity!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, I think the way you run is
just swell!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Er, am I being too forward for the city
folk?
S-sorry!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. Thank you, Yukino. I feel
better.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Okay, time to get back to it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
